slides.title: STL Containers Overview
slides.prompt: This Module Quiz covers C++ Standard Template Library sequence containers (std::vector, std::list, std::deque), associative containers (std::set, std::map), unordered containers, and container adaptors (std::stack, std::queue, std::priority_queue) (CPP_225 to CPP_232).

slides.title: Vector Insertion (CPP_225)
slides.prompt: Fill in the method name used to add a new element to the end of a std::vector.

slides.title: std::vector Memory Layout (CPP_225)
slides.prompt: How are elements stored in memory inside a std::vector?
options: In doubly-linked nodes spread across memory
In a balanced binary search tree

slides.title: List Container Header (CPP_226)
slides.prompt: Fill in the standard library header name required to use std::list.

slides.title: std::list Trait (CPP_226)
slides.prompt: What underlying data structure powers std::list in C++?

slides.title: Deque Both Ends Operations (CPP_227)
slides.prompt: Fill in the method used to insert an element at the beginning of a std::deque.

slides.title: std::set Uniqueness (CPP_228)
slides.prompt: Which statement is true regarding elements inside a std::set?
options: All elements are unique and automatically stored in sorted order
Elements can be duplicated and are unsorted
Elements are accessed strictly by integer index numbers
Elements can only be added at the end
slides.correctAnswer: All elements are unique and automatically stored in sorted order

slides.prompt: What type of data pairs does std::map store?
